plugins.name: investor-meeting-summary
plugins.description: Log investor meetings: pull the Otter.ai transcript, distill a structured investor-focused note, and file it through the CRM form so the Portal Contact tagging actually runs.

plugins.name: triage-note-updates
plugins.description: File startup triage notes from a Word doc, PDF or email into the company's Deal Flow record, move the pipeline stage, and tell the team what changed.

plugins.name: new-startup-form
plugins.description: Enter a new startup into the Venture base from its deck and email thread, found in Outlook when it can: duplicate check, questions asked as it goes, every form field drafted with a source, a pre-filled HubSpot contact form for any missing founder, then a pre-filled form link for you to finish and submit.
